Crypto exchange: daily challenge, 2026-11-15

The shared System Designer challenge for 2026-11-15: Crypto exchange. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

People trade coins, check prices and withdraw funds around the clock from every continent. A sudden price crash makes everyone log in and trade at once, attackers flood you hoping to knock the site over, and a leaked key could empty a wallet. Balances must never be wrong.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
